_source: Asianometry long video, watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-18: frame mosaics (0-15 s dense, 20-90 s every 5-10 s, then every ~2-4 min; some mid-video samples came back black and are left out), 0.5 s burst at 38-49 s, word timings and chapter headings from YouTube's transcript panel (about 135 words a minute, 18 chapters). Our own descriptions; not sound-probed. Shots after 90 s are spot samples.

hook.firstFrame: the channel's title card: an old painted city map, a green lower banner with the channel name and tagline
hook.firstLine: A state TV award names the company chairman a top economic figure.

shots.picture: channel card: old illustrated map of a river city, green banner with name and tagline, avatar
archive photo of the chairman with a trophy centred on black, caption line above, source credit bottom-left
a state-media web article centred on black with source line
close footage of an old lathe's dials and nameplate
factory footage, the video title in stacked green highlight boxes bottom-left, channel badge top-right
chapter card: one white word on a dimmed aerial view
satellite view of the city with a small label top-left and source line
1930s street photo centred on black with a title above and source below
full-frame photo of an old palace gate, blue label top-left
1940s factory photo centred on black, then workshop footage
archive photos, footage of machines, company logos, a mid-roll sponsor (spot-sampled)
city skyline photo, old factory photos, a factory in a valley, each labelled top-right
a bond prospectus page centred on black with source line
end card: 'for digging deeper' reading list beside a small photo

lines.gist: the chairman is honoured on state TV as a top economic figure
praised for turning a failing firm into a multi-billion giant
only seemingly: the firm was already sliding toward insolvency
this video traces how debt brought the giant down
chapter one: the city, its resources and warlord-era arms factories

whyItWorks: Opens on a moment of praise, then undercuts it in one line, and states the promise by 34 s.
Named chapters every 2 minutes make a 37-minute essay easy to follow.
Every picture is evidence with a caption and source line, which builds trust at a slow, calm pace.
